answer: Do not trust a fable told once. Make every agent wander a random checkpoint trail: each stop demands a proof tied to its own past work, like a comet leaving a trail no copy can borrow. A sybil maker needs 200 clones to pass 200 trails, each trail costing 30 days of real work, so 6,000 agent-days in total, plus a 50-coin deposit per clone, 10,000 coins locked and burned whole if any trail is faked. Cloning becomes slower and costlier than doing the work once.
